item: fixity lists say when they show only their first 200 rows
summary: Settings -> Integrity draws at most 200 rows per fixity list (diverged; not checkable). The backend list is complete, so when a list is longer a keyed line under it now reads 'Showing the first {shown} of {total}.' x12; a list at the cap shows no line. The cap itself is unchanged; the line repaints on a language switch with the rest of the panel.
